hero.title: Source Chinese Heat Exchanger Manufacturers with Clear Factory, Product, and Application Information
hero.subtitle: HeatEx Direct helps global procurement teams, engineers, project contractors, distributors, and system integrators identify, evaluate, and compare Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers before starting supplier conversations.

categories.title: Plate Heat Exchangers
categories.body: Gasketed and related plate heat exchangers for HVAC, food processing, marine systems, process cooling, and general heat recovery applications.

categories.title: Welded Plate Heat Exchangers
categories.body: Fully welded, wide-gap, plate-and-shell, and harsh-duty plate heat exchangers for higher pressure, higher temperature, corrosive media, or difficult fluids.

categories.title: Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers
categories.body: Tubular heat exchangers and pressure-vessel-style equipment for petrochemical, energy, power, marine, and heavy industrial service.

categories.title: Air-Side Heat Exchange Equipment
categories.body: Air coolers, air radiators, finned tube heat exchangers, and air-side thermal systems for cooling, heating, ventilation, and industrial process duties.

categories.title: Spare Parts and Service Items
categories.body: Replacement plates, gaskets, maintenance parts, documentation, and service-related components for heat exchanger lifecycle support.

evidence.label: Company Background
evidence.body: Legal company names, locations, business focus, short descriptions, and profile context for each listed manufacturer.

evidence.label: Factory Location
evidence.body: Factory locations, operating context, available facility media, and location details that help buyers understand the manufacturer's real-world presence.

evidence.label: Product Scope
evidence.body: Heat exchanger categories, product pages, application sectors, and related manufacturing capabilities connected to each supplier profile.

evidence.label: Technical Details
evidence.body: Product descriptions, materials, pressure and temperature relevance, application notes, heat load context, and design information where available.

evidence.label: Media and Visual Evidence
evidence.body: Product images, factory photos, certificates, documents, customer logos, and related files when supplied or verified.

evidence.label: Certificates and Documents
evidence.body: Available certificates, documents, qualification materials, and other proof points that buyers can review before deeper supplier due diligence.

howItWorks.title: Submit requirements for managed manufacturer follow-up
howItWorks.description: A useful heat exchanger quotation starts with clear operating conditions. HeatEx Direct reviews complete, verified quote requests and routes them within 2 business days according to email type and project fit.

steps.title: Check Fit
steps.body: Use manufacturer and product pages to review supplier capability, application experience, and available evidence.

steps.title: Submit Details
steps.body: Share your operating conditions, material needs, project notes, and other key requirements through the Get Quote form.

steps.title: Verify Email
steps.body: No account registration is required. Email verification confirms the request and determines whether it follows the business email or personal email routing tier.

steps.title: Receive Feedback
steps.body: Complete business email quote requests can be shared with 3-5 suitable manufacturers. Personal email quote requests are usually shared with up to 2.
